articleTitle: Lane line detection technology based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Lane detection is a key technology in automatic driving systems. Aiming at the problems of low accuracy and susceptible to interference in the traditional detection algorithm as for yellow lane lines, and poor recognition of curved lane lines by the traditional Hough transform. In this paper, a lane line detection method based on machine vision is proposed. Firstly, the white lane lines are identified in the gray space, the yellow lane lines are identified in the HSV space and the yellow lane lines and white lane lines are then merged. The interference is reduced by dividing the region of interest and Gaussian filtering. Then, the edge of the lane line is identified by edge detection and the image is transformed into an aerial view by inverse perspective transformation. Finally, the sliding window polynomial fitting method is adopted to fit the lane lines. At the same time, a lane departure warning method based on calculating curve curvature and center deviation is proposed.

articleTitle: Object Detection System Based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of image target detection in cloud computing mode, a target detection system suitable for edge devices is designed. First, the system selects Faster R-CNN in the deep learning algorithm as the target detection and recognition model, and trims the network feature extraction layer through the residual module. Second, a proposal region extraction sub-network with adjustable anchor boxes is used to obtain proposal regions more quickly by setting a convolutional sliding window of reasonable size. Finally, a complete target detection system is built using hardware such as Raspberry Pi development board and Intel neural computing stick. The experimental results on the KITTI dataset show that the system achieves good detection results, and achieves a faster recognition speed without reducing the target detection accuracy, which can meet the real-time requirements of offline work.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method of motor bearing based on EMD information entropy and decision tree
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The new power system has put forward higher requirements for the reliability of power supply. As the electrical energy conversion device, the research on the fault diagnosis method of the motor provides strong support for the reliability of the power supply. In this paper, the diagnosis of motor-bearing fault types is studied. The frequency domain extraction and EMD information entropy method are used to extract the characteristics of motor fault data. Then, the decision tree diagnosis model is trained and tested by using the feature data set. The experimental results show that the diagnostic accuracy rate of using only the frequency domain feature extraction data and decision tree is 85.67%, the macro F1 score is 0.8537, and the micro F1 score is 0.8567. In contrast, when the frequency domain feature and EMD information entropy feature are introduced into decision tree diagnosis at the same time. The accuracy of diagnosis can reach 93.29%, the macro F1 score reaches 0.9327, and the micro F1 score reaches 0.9329, which provides a new idea for studying motor fault diagnosis methods.

articleTitle: Water leakage detection and its application of turbine floor equipment based on MaskRCNN
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Water leakage detection is of great significance to reduce economic losses and safety hazards in industrial sites. Aiming at the problem of water leakage detection caused by weak light condition and uneven light on turbine layer, this paper proposes a water leakage detection method based on weak light compensation for MaskRCNN turbine layer equipment. Firstly, due to the poor light of the turbine layer, the boundary of the seepage area photographed by the inspection robot is not clear, and the segmentation method is difficult to determine the target boundary. In this paper, low light enhancement algorithm is used to process the image of water seepage area taken by inspection robot to strengthen the boundary of water seepage image. Then, software Labelme was used to label the water seepage area of the enhanced inspection image and generate the configuration file corresponding to the inspection image. Thirdly, MaskRCNN instance segmentation network is introduced to train the image of the seepage area, and the network model of the detection task of the seepage area is generated. Finally, the test image is used to detect the water seepage area. After weak light enhancement, the trained MaskRCNN model is imported to obtain the detection result of the water seepage area. The experimental results show that the proposed method is effective and accurate, and it has a good application effect in detecting water dripping and leakage of turbine floor equipment by the wheel inspection machine in Qingyuan Energy Storage Power Generation Station.

articleTitle: DEIM: An effective deep encoding and interaction model for sentence matching
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Sentence matching is to compare the relevance of two paragraphs of sentences. The current mainstream approach is a deep learning-based approach, usually through the attention mechanism to interact with sentence pairs, which can be a good match for the relationship between two sentences. However, these methods cannot handle sentences with high semantic complexity. Therefore, we propose a method that is based on a deep encoder to extract deep semantic information. To avoid the problem of an insufficient number of interactions to lack information, we encode sentences at the coding layer using the method of multiple encoded interactions. After we get the representation information of the sentence, in this paper, the encoded sentences are processed for secondary interaction of information, while using self-attention to obtain more complex feature interaction information. We conducted experimental validation on some text-matching datasets, and the experimental results show that our proposed DEIM model plays an irreplaceable and important role in the task of text matching.

articleTitle: Research on Intersection Signal Timing Based on Multi-Objective Linear Combination
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The traditional signal timing at intersections is only from the point of improving the traffic efficiency, and it does not take into account the pedestrian factors at intersections and vehicle exhaust emissions, which is easy to aggravate environmental pollution. This paper examines the relationship between vehicle delay, pedestrian delay, parking rates, traffic capacity and exhaust emissions, and develops a hierarchical multi-objective optimization signals framework to optimize fixed-time traffic based on survey at isolated signalized interactions. The optimized frame is solved by the particle swarm optimization, and the traffic light time of each phase is calculated by the flow ratio formulas. Using this method, the vehicle delay can be reduced by 18.7%, the queue length can be reduced by 15.5%. To a certain extent, using this timing scheme can improve road capacity, reduce traffic accidents, reduce tail gas emissions and reduce road congestion.

articleTitle: Weather Analysis and Prediction based on Bagging Regression
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: From ancient times to the present, weather has been an inseparable factor for human activities. With the development and progress of the times, modern society increasingly needs to conduct accurate analysis and prediction of weather to ensure normal human activities. For this reason, this paper proposes a method for weather analysis and prediction based on bagging regression. First, the weather-related historical data of a certain area is obtained; then the original data is simply cleaned; Then use the bagging regression algorithm of the integrated learning in machine learning to model and analyze; the last step is to use the model just built for new data prediction. According to multiple test analysis, it can be concluded that the method model is simple and easy to use, and can provide a certain supporting basis for the analysis and prediction of weather-related data.

articleTitle: Face Detection with Improved Faster-R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the continuous development of convolutional neural network, object detection technology has made great progress. As a representative of the two-stage object detection algorithm, faster-r-cnn achieves high precision in object detection tasks. However, there are still many difficulties and challenges using fater-r-cnn to detect faces. For example, tiny faces in the images are not detected, and side faces or occluded faces are prone to be detected as false detections. In response to those questions raised above, this paper improves faster-r-cnn algorithm in the following aspects: we replaced the feature extraction network in the faster-r-cnn algorithm and used feature pyramid networks, which is more beneficial to detect tiny faces. Besides, we used classification loss function which is more conducive to classification task, and for the special sizes of faces, we set the anchor ratio matching mechanism. In addition, we used suitable activation function to increase the nonlinear fitting ability of the whole network, and for the problem of the training set of WIDER FACE database, we cleaned it in order to get better experimental results. As a consequence, our method achieved 96.2% mAP on FDDB and 93.6%, 88.5%, 62.6% mAP respectively on the easy, medium, hard set of WIDER FACE, and our method could run at 10 FPS on Nvidia GTX 1080Ti GPU.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In recent years, telecommunication has become the major media of communication, while the market has been saturated in many developed countries. Telecommunication companies are shifting their concerns from acquiring new customers to retaining regular customers, since the cost to win a new customer is higher than that of maintaining a regular customer. Therefore, it is essential for telecommunication operators to forecast customer churn in this competitive, accurate market. This paper aims to identify affecting customer churn and construct an efficient model, which is used to predict and analyze data with visualization results. The churn forecast consists of several phases: data prepossessing, data analysis, evaluation measure, and application of machine learning algorithms. Moreover, data pre-processing covers data cleaning, transformation, and classification. The machine learning classifiers selected are Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, AdaBoost, GBDT, XGBoost, Light GBM, and CatBoost. Classifiers were evaluated using performance measures, such as accuracy, precision, recall, AUC, and F1-Score. Based on the paper, the result was shown that the Light GBM outperformed other classifiers while identifying potential churners.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of tethered UAV system under tension
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to analyze the modal of the tethered UAV system, the motion of the UAV is treated as the boundary condition of the tether, and coupling dynamic model of the tethered UAV system is obtained. Considering the aerodynamic force of the tethered UAV system, the approximate expressions of the equilibrium tension and the equilibrium curvature of the tether are derived. On the basis of rebalancing analysis, the nonlinear equations of the tethered UAV system are linearized, and the normal natural frequencies and modes of the tethered cables are obtained. The influence of cable length and UAV load mass on the normal natural frequency and mode shape of mooring line is studied. It is found that with the increase of cable length and load mass, the forward second-order frequency of mooring method decreases continuously, and the normal second order frequency decreases more than the first order frequency. When the UAV’s load mass is fixed, the first normal mode shape of the mooring line changes little with the increase of the length of the mooring line. When the length of the cable is fixed, with the increase of the UAV load mass, the natural frequencies of the mooring method change little. When the wind excitation frequency of the system is close to the frequency of the system, the resonance of the system can be avoided by changing the length of the cable and load mass of the UAV to maintain the normal operation of the system. These studies provide a theoretical basis for the normal operation of the tethered UAV system.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Quantum Key Distribution in 5G Power Private Network Communication Under Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper proposes a distribution network application scheme based on quantum secure communication and 5G hard slicing private network. The method can calculate the quantum key update frequency and distribution strategy of each power business by itself. The system performs the key self-evolution of the synchronization between the sender and the receiver by transmitting the random quantity of short length generated in the communication in the quantum channel. It replaces the traditional update method where a new full key must be sent and received after each update must be renegotiated. Finally, this paper proposes the key reading mode between the service terminal and the quantum key mobile storage device, the interface protocol between the service terminal device and the quantum key mobile storage device, and the key management method suitable for the power distribution service terminal. The experimental results show that the described method can realize the automation and intelligence of the optimal distribution of quantum keys for accurate data protection of various power services. This method can construct a precise and secure data protection mechanism based on quantum keys.

articleTitle: A Study of Fatigue Driving Detection System Based on AdaBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, a fatigue driving detection system is designed. Firstly, the real-time collected facial images of vehicle drivers are pre-processed, and the AdaBoost algorithm classifier is used to locate the faces and eyes. Then the edge detection and contour extraction are performed on the obtained eye images to get the degree of eye opening and closing. Next, the proportion of the eye-closing time to the total observation time is calculated in combination with the perclos fatigue driving standard to determine whether fatigue is achieved. When fatigue is achieved, the system will give an early warning to wake up the driver who is sleepy. The simulation results show that this method has strong real-time performance, high detection accuracy and strong practicability.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The current YOLOv3 algorithm also has shortcomings in dealing with pedestrian detection problems, such as pedestrian missed detection, false detection, and pedestrian multi-pose change problems. Therefore, an improved algorithm based on the YOLOv3 algorithm for accurate pedestrian detection in images was proposed. The algorithm introduces the CSPNet structure and the ECA attention mechanism to the original YOLOv3 algorithm, which greatly reduces the amount of computation compared with the original algorithm, and the performance is significantly improved. The experiment in this paper is based on the INRIA dataset,and the experimental results show that the detection performance of the optimized algorithm is better.Compared with the original YOLOv3 network, the optimized algorithm improves the mAP value by 93.89%.

articleTitle: Prediction of Laser-TIG Weld Profile Based on Neural Network and Intelligent Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, the laser-TIG laser is used for laser welding of Q235 stainless steel with a thickness of 1mm, 2mm, 4mm, and 6mm. This paper combines BP neural network and database technology to design a database system for laser-TIG welding process parameter optimization based on BP neural network. At the same time, this paper converts the input and output parameters of the model and obtains a network model for predicting welding process parameters by using the three topographical size parameters of penetration depth, penetration width, and residual height. This improves the precision and quality of the laser welding process. When the number of BP network training reaches more than 5000 times, the output accuracy of the system is better than 0.015mm. At this time, the maximum errors of the measured value of the welding fusion width ratio and the width of the weld and the network output value are 0.03mm and 0.07mm, respectively. This system can avoid much experimentation. At the same time, it can also significantly shorten the research cycle of hybrid welding. The algorithm is of great significance to the optimization of welding process parameters.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Home WiFi Smoke Alarm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization, fire safety issues become more and more prominent. Especially the old urban areas are the key risk areas, which are easy to develop, spread quickly and difficult to exterminate. The lack of necessary alarm devices has led to a dead end in the community. When a fire occurs due to the aging of the line, it cannot be effectively monitored by computer technology, resulting in a serious delay in rescue fire. At present, domestic WiFi smoke alarms are still in the stage of development and popularization. Smoke alarms have been set up in general public places and newly built residential areas according to relevant regulations. In the traditional old residential areas, there is still a blank area without the installation and use of smoke alarms. This design takes Espressif 8685 as the main control chip, TCRT5000L as the smoke sensor, and uses the smoke photoelectric technology to realize the smoke detection. The WiFi smoke alarm is fast, easy to operate and has high accuracy, especially in areas prone to fire hazard.

articleTitle: Optimization of Vaccine Production in Workshop Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the face of some infectious diseases raging all over the world, the efficiency of vaccine production directly affects the ability of medical staff to rescue patients and the timeliness of global epidemic prevention. Therefore, it is of great significance to establish an optimal planning model from the production source to minimize the time required for vaccine production without affecting the quality of vaccine production. This paper analyzes and discusses the problem of vaccine production from two aspects. Firstly, under ideal conditions, without considering the impact of vaccine production time, based on the average time of producing each box of vaccine at each station, a scheduling optimization model with multi-objective constraints is established, and then the flow shop scheduling model (FSP) of genetic algorithm is used to solve it. We estimate that the gene assignment adopts a classical roulette algorithm, the gene crossover part adopts the partial mapping crossover algorithm, and the gene mutation step uses the gene reverse order algorithm to simulate the operation of the stack. In practice, the time required to produce each vaccine at each station is random. Bring in the normal probability distribution function, improve the genetic algorithm and shorten the total time by 5%.

Author Keywords: Scheduling optimization model with multi-objective constraints

articleTitle: Infrared Image Target Detection Algorithm for Hardware Fittings at Tension Clamp of Qishao UHV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The infrared thermal imager is a common method for electric inspection to detect the abnormal heat of the gold tool at the tensioning wire clamp. Because the Gansu section of Qishao High voltage line accounts for about 52.4% of the total length, through a lot of complex geographical environment, even once a quarter manual inspection will cost time and effort, subjectivity is big, and real-time performance is poor. Aiming at the above, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv4 multi-target recognition algorithm for infrared images. Firstly, the backbone feature extraction network CSPDaeknet53 is replaced by Mobilenetv1. Secondly, the training dataset is increased by the base hjs image expansion technology. Finally, Mosaic data enhancement and cosine annealing attenuation technology are introduced to construct an effective infrared image detection model to realize the classification and recognition of the hardware. The experimental results are compared with SSD, YOLOv3 and YOLOv4 target detection algorithms, and it is found that the average recognition accuracy of the proposed method is 93.84%, and the model size is only 55.53MB. Under the condition of ensuring accuracy, the model is smaller and has practical reference value.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction Model Based on LSTM Deep Learning: The Case of Top Corporate Company in China
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The fluctuation of stock market price is the basis of stock market operation. The big fluctuation of stock market price will cause huge losses to investors. Stock price fluctuation is a highly complex nonlinear system, the price adjustment is not in accordance with the uniform time process, has its own process, has high risk, is very difficult to predict. The stock prediction topic is one of the most explored area of research. However, due to the characteristics of large quantity, non-linearity and long memory of stock price data, the traditional machine learning methods have some problems, such as few model parameters, impractical, time-consuming prediction and so on. Therefore, how to study effective deep learning methods to improve the recognition efficiency and prediction accuracy of forecasting models is an urgent problem to be solved in the field of stock forecasting. Based on the theory of deep learning, this paper constructs a stock price prediction index system according to the characteristics of China’s top enterprises. In this paper, the stock price trend of Build Your Dreams (BYD), the top new energy vehicle company in China, is taken as the main data set, and the Long and Short-term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network is used to predict BYD’s stock price. This paper solves the long sequence dependence problem in general recursive neural networks. Using the characteristics of recurrent neural network and stock market, the data are preprocessed by interpolation and wavelet denoising, and then pushed to different LSTM layers. Training and testing were carried out in LSTM network models with different numbers of hidden neurons at the same level. The evaluation indexes and prediction effects were compared to find the appropriate LSTM layers and hidden neurons to improve the prediction accuracy

articleTitle: Master Cylinder Oil Pressure Following Control Algorithm of Electric Power Assisted Braking System Based on Fuzzy PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: It is very important for the braking force control of the electric power assisted braking system to establish the oil pressure of the brake master cylinder quickly and accurately. However, the braking hydraulic pressure response of the system has obvious nonlinear characteristics, and it is arduous to control the master cylinder oil pressure by establishing an accurate mathematical model. To propose relevant solutions to these problems, this paper proposes a fuzzy PID controller on the ground of electric power brake system master cylinder oil pressure following control algorithm. Firstly, the transfer function between the identified torque and the oil pressure is used for determining the initial value of PID parameters through simulation. Then, the deviation and deviation variation of the oil pressure are taken as the input variable of fuzzy controller. The variation of PID parameters is obtained by fuzzy reasoning method. The incremental PID algorithm is used to obtain the incremental value of the output torque, and then the actual value of the torque can be obtained. The controller realizes the purpose of establishing oil pressure by controlling the power motor to drive the piston of hydraulic cylinder. By analyzing the experimental results, we can know that the method has high control accuracy, fast adjustment speed, and excellent following consequence in three states of master cylinder oil pressure rising, maintaining, and falling.

articleTitle: Short-time Passenger Flow Prediction Model based on Combined Model for Large Events in and Out of Rail Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Addressing the difficulties of acyclicity, strong abruptness and little historical passenger flow data in predicting short-time passenger flow in and out of rail stations during large events, an UKF-AMLSTM-based short-time passenger flow prediction model is established. Considering large event factors and other external factors, unique thermal coding is performed and then used as input to the Two Layer Long Short Term Memory Network (LSTM) along with the historical passenger flow data after flat Unscented Kalman filter (UKF) slip processing, with Attention Mechanism (AM) added to identify key input steps. The validity of the model is verified by taking Shanghai Metro Xujing East Station as an example. The research results can provide a basis for the development and optimization of passenger organization schemes in rail stations during large events.

Author Keywords: short-time passenger flow prediction for large events

articleTitle: PCTran-Cloud: an Accident Simulator for Nuclear Power Plants Based on Cloud Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the current environment where COVID-19 is serious, the space, place and resources required for teaching nuclear power plants are restricted to a great extent. To solve such problems and improve the utilization of education resources, this study improved an accident simulator for nuclear power plants based on the concept of cloud technology. We build the Browser / Server architecture so that the platform has successfully implemented multiterminal, multiplatform and multiuser simultaneous applications. Through the simulation results of the Small Break Loss of Coolant Accident (SBLOCA) and the test results of platform performance by PCTran-Cloud, the correctness of PCTran-Cloud in the accident simulation function and results were verified. In general, PCTran-Cloud has the characteristics of high scalability, high concurrency and high security. The platform can provide an environment for the training and education of nuclear power professionals.

articleTitle: Adaptive t-distribution Drosophila Algorithm Based on Tent Mapping and Reverse Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The Fruit Fly Algorithm (FOA) is a global search algorithm that is easy to implement and has few parameters. Aiming at the problems of traditional fruit fly algorithms, an adaptive Drosophila T-distribution algorithm based on tent mapping and reverse learning (TTOBL-FOA) is proposed. The Drosophila population is initialized by tent chaotic map, which improves the diversity of the population. In the search phase, the Drosophila search step strategy adopts t distribution variation to reduce the algorithm faffing into local optimum In the iterative stage, the elite fruit flies in the reverse learning population generate reverse solutions, retain the individuals with better taste concentration in the population, and improve the search range of the algorithm, thereby enhancing the convergence accuracy. The experimental data of six standard test functions and high-dimensional multimodal test functions show that the TTOBL-FOA algorithm has been optimized in terms of the convergence of the optimal value, the stability of the algorithm and the performance of global optimization.

articleTitle: Bird Movement Recognition Research Based on YOLOv4 Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Taking the basic daily behavior of birds as the research object of this paper, the deep learning object detection algorithm is used to identify and detect the behavior and behavior of birds. Using the YOLOv4 model to extract features to complete the recognition of bird behavior and action and the location of birds, this study first crawled target images from the computer vision website and the China Bird Network, Pass the bird action image into the model after processing, and used the CSPdarknet network for feature extraction. Feature enhancement processing is carried out using PANet and SPP to expand the sensory field of view. In order to make the research results better applied to reality Finally, positioning and classification are implemented through the header layer. The yolo family of algorithms utilizes an end-to-end idea to revert to boundary locations and classifications using only a one-time feature extraction. This enables rapid capture and identification of bird targets, as well as real-time monitoring through OpenCV invocation of monitoring devices. The web front-end system is set up using the flask framework, and the results of model detection and recognition are passed to the backend to obtain more training data and optimize the model. The research shows that the yolov4 object detection and recognition algorithm can accurately capture the position of birds in images and videos and identify their behavior. The research of bird behavior and motion recognition is the exploration and prospect of deep learning algorithms in the biological field, which provides a feasible intelligent solution for the modernization of ecological civilization.

articleTitle: Design of Pedestrian Detection System based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Since the emergence of computer vision, pedestrian detection technology has been widely concerned by scholars at home and abroad. The technology is widely used in real-time monitoring, intelligent transportation and human-computer interaction. Most of the existing pedestrian detection systems have problems such as large program volume, high dependence on operating environment, and inability to guarantee recognition rate in complex situations. In order to improve these problems, a pedestrian detection system based on OpenCV vision library is designed, which uses deep learning framework for reasoning and separates model training from prediction. Firstly, YOlOv5 based on PyTorch framework is rewritten under OpenCV DNN framework, and the core algorithm of target recognition including intersection over union, non-maximum suppression and other modules is written. Then the user interface of pedestrian monitoring system is developed on Windows platform. Finally, multi-scene experiments are carried out to verify that the designed pedestrian monitoring system has high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: A composite optimal predictive guidance law for hypersonic target interception
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The hypersonic target has the characteristics of a large attack angle, fast flight speed, and strong maneuverability in the reentry phase, whereas the missile has a relatively low speed, which puts forward a high overload requirement for the missile. In order to reduce the overload requirement of missile, a composite optimal predictive guidance law is proposed. Firstly, a tactical Lambert guidance is proposed based on Lambert problem. When the missile and target maneuver in the existing way, the missile can intercept the target under the condition of zero-effort. Then, an optimal predictive guidance law is designed to satisfy the initial conditions of Lambert guidance based on variational method. Finally, considering that the target maneuvering mode will change during the guidance process, a predictive guidance law based on the zero-effort miss distance is designed to correct the missile trajectory. The simulation results show that the composite optimal predictive guidance law can effectively reduce the missile’s overload when intercepting hypersonic targets, and improve the guidance accuracy; in addition, when the target maneuvering mode does not change, the time-to-go can be accurately estimated.

articleTitle: Research on colour recognition sorting method of waste plastic bottles based on computer perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: As a low-cost, easy-to-use, easy processing and manufacturing, light weight, widely used material, plastic is in great demand and production in people’s daily life. 2021 annual, China’s total output of plastic products 80.04 million tons, an increase of 5.27% year-on-year. The large amount of plastic waste casually used and discarded is gradually becoming an environmental problem that is difficult for human beings to deal with. The current high-tech development is slow and difficult to meet the current demand, so recycling plastic waste is still the main improvement path at present. The recycled waste plastic bottles, after colour screening, can be treated as raw materials for reproduction with high economic benefits. And because of the high cost and low efficiency of manual sorting, this paper aims to improve the efficiency of plastic bottle colour sorting, for three aspects of image acquisition, image pre-processing and colour classification, and proposes a computer perspective-based plastic bottle colour recognition and classification system, which can greatly improve the efficiency of plastic bottle sorting.

articleTitle: Low-Power Wireless Sensor Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper designs a kind of wireless sensor based on ZigBee technology, to reduce the power consumption of sensors by means of sleep design in the case of limited energy supply, sensor nodes thus get a longer lifetime. In addition, aiming at the command parameter transfer problem caused by wireless silence in sensor node sleep, the response mechanism design is improved to ensure effective control of the terminal sensor node by the server. Corresponding experiments are designed to verify the sensor node design scheme.

articleTitle: Research on On-line State Monitoring Method of Voltage Transformer based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: After the emerging energy is incorporated into the power system, the harmonic problem of the power system is becoming more and more serious. How to accurately measure electric energy is the key to ensure the stable operation of the power system. Voltage transformer is one of the key equipment of electric energy measurement. Whether its operating state is normal or not plays a vital role in its measurement performance. Therefore, an on-line state monitoring method of voltage transformer based on digital twins is proposed. Select appropriate state characteristic parameters (actual transformation ratio, angular difference, relative capacitance and grounding current coefficient of voltage transformer), and construct the digital twin model of voltage transformer in combination with the requirements of state monitoring. According to the model, the twin data of voltage transformer under different state backgrounds are obtained, and the sensitivity of state characteristic parameters is analyzed to determine the change law of state characteristic parameters. Based on the change law, the state types and corresponding labels of voltage transformer are divided, and the on-line state of voltage transformer is evaluated through network probabilistic neural network (PNN), so as to realize the monitoring of on-line state of voltage transformer. The experimental data shows that the state monitoring parameters of voltage transformer obtained by the proposed method are small, and the accuracy of state monitoring is as high as 90.00%, which proves that the proposed method has better state monitoring performance.

articleTitle: K-Means Cluster Analysis Based on Consumer Behavior
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Consumer behavior analysis in this society has a very important role, use kaggle prospective analysis of open datasets, hoping to provide reference for future research. First, we can using the k-means clustering algorithm to build a model for different category of consumer, and explore associations between data points based on clustering, and give platform builders a certain reference from a commercial point of view. The experimental results show that the method of using business intelligence can well predict the future consumption tendency of different consumer groups. If the sample size were able continuously increasing, feature point and a multidimensional matrix can be formed with sample, K-means algorithm will achieve better results.

articleTitle: Small Sample Phase Selection Method Based on GASF and Swin-Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper presents the method of three-phase fault arc small sample phase selection based on Gramian Angular Summation Fields (GASF) and Swin-Transformer. This method builds the low voltage three-phase arc fault data acquisition platform, collect each phase fault signal and establish the data set. To capture the correlation features of fault information and spatial information, the experimental data were transformed into two-dimensional images using GASF. Using the hierarchical construction method of Swin-Transformer, the attention computation of the model is concentrated on each divided attention map to reduce the memory footprint and the operation amount. This model was trained and tested for the dataset using the GASF feature graph. The results show that the accuracy is 98.75% in low voltage three-phase fault.

articleTitle: Research progress of single-stage small target detection based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Small target detection has long been a difficult and key research direction in target detection. Based on extensive literature research, this paper first summarizes the definition of small target and the application and difficulties of small target detection. Secondly, the optimization methods for small target detection are summarized from the aspects of anchor box, network structure, IOU and loss function, and the commonly used small target detection data sets are introduced. Finally, the future research direction of single-stage small target detection technology is prospected.

articleTitle: Research on Self-Attention Image Description Technology Based on Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Image description is transform the image into a text description that tells about the image, but the characters in the image and their attributes and relationships will affect the one-to-one correspondence between the text description and the image. In response to the above problems, we design an encode-decoder structure based on a self-aware target detector to extract distinct feature and role information, and design a role integrity check module to supplement the description sentences with rich object information, which improves the accuracy of image description for role in the image. We have conducted many experiments on Flickr8k and Flickr30k and on the MS COCO dataset, this method can make the generated image description and images have better semantic consistency, and compared with traditional deep learning methods and the semantic diversity has a good effect.

articleTitle: Aerospace Intelligent Equipment System Based on Embedded Heterogeneous Design for PHM
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper proposes research on the prediction and health management system (PHM) of aircraft conditional maintenance based on massive data mining. This paper reviews the development history and development status of PHM technology in foreign aircraft engines, fixed-wing aircraft, helicopters, aerospace vehicles, ships, vehicles and rail transit equipment, and then according to the status quo, from the perspectives of system structure, service environment, data sources and storage methods, etc. The application requirements of new generation aircraft for massive data mining are analyzed. Thirdly, based on the data mining work of prediction and health management, this paper proposes a device life prediction method based on Gaussian Hidden Markov Model. The method is divided into an offline stage and an online stage. The offline stage extracts sensor data features and trains model parameters. The second stage then utilizes the model to assess the current state of device health. Finally, this paper proposes an embedded heterogeneous design aircraft PHM massive data mining platform. And designed the overall framework and hardware and software structure of the platform. Finally, this paper takes the aircraft bearing as an example to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm and data platform proposed in this paper. The experimental simulation shows that the data mining efficiency of the system is high, and the accuracy of the equipment life prediction method is as high as 95%. The platform has great military application significance for promoting the integration and engineering realization of aircraft PHM.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic emulation analysis of bionic bat micro flapping-wing aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, we simulate and analyze a bionic bat micro flapping-wing aircraft aerodynamic by using the finite element analysis method of ANSYS. It is concluded that when the pitch angle is 0°, the lift of the micro flapping-wing aircraft is the smallest. According to the fitting curve based on the simulation data, when the wind speed is 5.8m/s, the maximum lift is 0.000932N. In addition, the flapping-wing aircraft can obtain positive lift with a downward position, and negative lift with an upward position. Under the same wind speed, the lift change rate caused by the same angle of attack change gradient will also change significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Strengthening Structure of Converter Valve Tower in High Seismic Intensity Area
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to meet the seismic requirements in high earthquake intensity areas, a valve tower being developed was taken as the research object to be improved. Firstly, the finite element model of the valve tower was established. On the basis, four kinds of tower-top strengthened structure schemes were proposed. Secondly, modal analysis and response spectrum analysis of five seismic schemes were carried out with the same boundary conditions and simulation method. Finally, the simulation results were processed to verify the shock absorption effect of the design. The simulation results showed that the displacement of the top of the valve tower was large under the earthquake condition. Using the tower-top strengthened structure schemes, the displacement could be effectively reduced. Among them, the 30-degree tower-top strengthened structure scheme had a better effect on both reducing the stress as well as the displacement which aimed to provide a basis for structural design of valve tower in high earthquake intensity areas.

articleTitle: The Yellow River Walker Beach Garbage Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper introduces a garbage cleaning robot based on the development technology of Raspberry Pi in the Yellow River beach. This paper introduces a kind of beach garbage cleaning robot by introducing the problem of garbage in the Yellow River beach in reality. This paper also introduces the related technologies of robots, and proposes and designs a robot solution for beach garbage cleaning.

Author Keywords: Yellow River Walker - Beach Garbage Cleaning Robot

articleTitle: An Energy Optimization Algorithm for Data Centers based on Deep Q-learning with Multi-Source Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: More and more data centers are supplied by multi-source energy. However, the features of random, uncertain, and time-varying of renewable energy has made it difficult to achieve good results with traditional methods. In this paper, we research how to coordinate multiple energy sources (such as wind power, solar, and smart grids) to reduce energy costs of data centers. We propose a deep Q-learning (DQN) algorithm based on the auto encoder to control the energy consumption of data center. Our algorithm uses the auto encoder to approximate the Q-value function, learning the expected cost based on the state of current system. It solves the problem that the Q-value function in traditional Q-learning algorithm is difficultly designed under multi-constraint conditions, and it can converge by any state of the system to obtain the optimal solution. In order to further improve the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm. We design a parameter optimization strategy to solve the slow convergence problem of the algorithm. This strategy is based on the experience replay technology to optimize the parameters of algorithm. We conducted extensive experiments based on real- world data, and evaluated the performance of our algorithm. The experiment results show that our algorithm can average save 20% energy cost so as to bring a set of safe and highly available solution to meet the requirements of multi-Source energy for data centers.

articleTitle: Driving Structure Design and Analysis of Multi- DOF Bionic Flapping Wing Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to improve the flight performance of flapping-wing aircraft, a new multi-degree-of-freedom bionic flapping-wing driving mechanism is designed based on the flight motion characteristics of gulls: The dual-crank and dual-rocker mechanism is used as the driving mechanism, and the two- segment wing structure is used as the wing to realize the expansion and folding function of the wing. The planar double crank rocker mechanism and spatial crank rocker mechanism are coupled through bevel gears so that the aileron can twist during wing flapping. The whole moving process is only driven by a DC brushless motor with a simple structure and high flight efficiency. Firstly, the kinematic model of flapping-wing vehicle driving mechanism is established through kinematic analysis. Then, the simulation analysis model of the flapping-wing mechanism is established in ADAMS simulation software, which verifies the theoretical analysis. The results show that the designed driving mechanism can realize multi-degree-of- freedom coupling motion of flapping, torsion, and folding by single-degree-of-freedom driving. The upper flapping limit is 22.6°, the lower flapping limit is -21.5°, the maximum torsion angle is 10.5°, the minimum torsion angle is -16.6°, and the folding angle range is 144.7°~192.1°. The output trajectory is the same as the wingtip trajectory of the seagull when flying and has good aerodynamic performance. The kinematic parameters obtained from the simulation are consistent with the theoretical calculation, which verifies the correctness of the theoretical calculation.

articleTitle: Modeling and Prediction of Vehicle Trajectory in the Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the continuous improvement of people's quality of life and the gradual increase of the number of cars in the city, the driving safety and efficiency of traditional cars have become a common concern. Whether it is some advanced driving assistance systems or auto drive system, it is an indispensable part of the whole system to accurately predict the future trajectory of other vehicles in the driving environment. Therefore, this paper studies the modeling and prediction of vehicle trajectory based on the Internet of vehicles. A multi task learning method is proposed, and the vehicle trajectory modeling and prediction based on multi task learning are discussed. At the same time, the analysis and modeling of vehicle collision warning at intersections are studied. Finally, by testing the impact of the dimension of the activity area on the trajectory coordinate prediction performance, it is verified that the model proposed in this paper can achieve better results, and the prediction performance of the model with auxiliary tasks is better than that without auxiliary tasks, it is of great significance to the driving safety and efficiency of vehicles in the future.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation Analysis Applied in Intelligent Lightweight Sorting Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the problem of microplastics in the soil, this paper starts from the main purpose of loving nature and protecting nature in today's society, and designs a soil ploughing and microplastic treatment integrated vehicle for dealing with microplastics problems in polluted areas, reducing the microplastic content of soil, and realizing ecological restoration of soil. The device plans the recycling path of microplastics through Beidou navigation, and completes the functions of soil turning and recycling microplastics through Archimedes spiral stirring rods, adsorption devices and other mechanisms.

articleTitle: Research on Night Scene Image Enhancement Algorithm Based on Half-pixel Constraint
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Due to the relatively concentrated distribution of gray value in night scene image, it is often necessary to improve the visual effect of the image by widening and lifting the gray value, so as to further clarify the details and facilitate the subsequent processing operation. To solve the problem that the traditional contrast enhancement algorithm often enlarges the noise when processing the image, which affects the visual quality of the enhanced image, a half pixel constrained image enhancement algorithm is proposed. The algorithm divides the night scene image into bright and dark regions according to the gray value corresponding to the half pixel of the image, and uses bi-directional histogram equalization to realize the half pixel constraint in the bright region, so as to suppress the signal-to-noise ratio, while the traditional double histogram equalization is still used in the dark region. The experimental results show that the algorithm can better preserve the details of the original night scene image, and has the ability to deal with the noise interference.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Media Interactive Technology in Remote Control of Picking Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the design process of the picking robot automation system, this paper introduces the picking robot communication and interaction system based on the principle of interactive audio-visual English learning. The purpose is to improve the control efficiency of the picking robot. The system innovation proposes to collect human joint skeleton information based on the depth camera Kinect. In this paper, information such as joint position offset and bone rotation angle are calculated through space vector calculation. Then this paper uses the voice control technology to adjust the working posture of the picking robot to realize the video and audio interaction between the administrator and the picking robot. It can effectively improve the operation quality of the picking robot and reduce the failure rate of the picking robot. The test results show that the picking robot can accurately identify the voice-controlled signal at the remote end. In this paper, the accuracy of the action according to the command signal is high, which can meet the design requirements of high-precision picking robots.

articleTitle: BLE Complex Environment Location Method and System Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, remote sensing technology has been widely used in various fields, using GPS, kinematic algorithms and other methods to track and locate targets. However, the ble (Bluetooth Low Energe) environment cannot accurately obtain the target coordinate information (including position, distance and attitude) in the complex environment. In addition, the key is to accurately and quickly obtain the 3D spatial data of the human body and give the corresponding matching results. Therefore, this paper proposes a method based on the ble (Bluetooth Low Energe) system model to assist the positioning solution of the complex environment to calculate the most accurate coordinates. This paper introduces the concept and characteristics of ble (Bluetooth Low Energe), then expounds the method of location in complex environment, and then studies the application method of machine learning algorithm. Finally, the simulation verifies that the tracking algorithm can accurately locate the complex environment. The test results show that the complex environment positioning system based on machine algorithm has high accuracy and small error. This shows that the system can meet the needs of accurate positioning in complex environments.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Analysis on the Iced Conductor with the Aerodynamic Dampers
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Galloping of overhead transmission lines is a kind of instability phenomenon created by the wind excitation and asymmetric ice layer on the conductor. It may lead to the damage of overhead transmission lines. In this paper, the aerodynamic characteristics of four kinds of beam conductors with aerodynamic dampers are studied on the basis of wind tunnel tests. To perform such analysis, the aerodynamic coefficients for four bundle conductors with different aerodynamic dampers under different wind directions and different ice-coat were obtained. The tests showed that the drag coefficient of leeward conductors increased about 10% while the lift and moment coefficients decreased about 46% and 23%. The numbers of negative Den Hartog coefficients are respectively about 22.2% (different attack angles) and 70.0% (different ice angles) less than the case without any aerodynamic damper.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition of Control Chart Based on Fuzzy c-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The pattern recognition of the control chart can distinguish the Normal factors and unnatural factors in the manufacturing process, improve the quality of products in the manufacturing process, reduce costs and improve benefits in the environment of industrial big data. Due to the fact that manufacturing process data are becoming more and more complicated under the environment of big data, the fundamental assumptions of traditional statistical process control methods are no longer invalid, which makes them unreliable to recognize the control chart patterns effectively. In this paper, the Monte Carlo method is used to generate samples. One-dimensional discrete wavelet transform is used to process the original data. The fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm is used to recognize the control chart pattern. The recognition accuracy was 99.43%, and its standard deviation was 0.0028. It shows that the method based on the control chart pattern recognition has high accuracy, good stability, and is simple and efficient compared with the existing control chart pattern recognition methods.

articleTitle: Quality Defect Recognition Method Based on Variable Precision Rough Set and Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of how to quickly identify the types of quality defects in the quality control of mechanical products in the manufacturing process, a quality defect identification method in the manufacturing process based on variable precision rough set and deep belief network is proposed. The variable precision rough set is used to reduce the dimension of quality characteristics influencing factor data, and the quality defect recognition model is established combined with the deep belief network algorithm to classify the quality defects of the quality problems in the manufacturing process of mechanical products. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the model are verified by an example of crankshaft machining.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Oil Trading Data Analysis and Prediction based on Random Forest Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's quality of life, some people will put out some money to invest in stocks. In order to better help investment, this article takes the historical oil transaction data as an example, first obtains the historical oil transaction data published by the relevant financial websites; then simply analyzes the obtained data; and then visualizes the relationship between the real data; Finally, the random forest regression algorithm in machine learning is used for modeling. After training, the closing price, the highest price, the lowest price, the opening pricAe, the best fitting curve and the best number of decision trees corresponding to the previous closing historical transaction data were obtained respectively. For newly incoming data, the following data can be predicted using the fitted curve. After the actual test, the modeling effect is good, and it can provide the basis for people who need to buy stocks.

articleTitle: Research and passing ability optimization of hybrid-driven connecting rod leg based on jansen mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Hybrid-driven linkage mechanism has been applied to the leg design of multi-legged robots. However, in the existing research, the mechanism only adjusts the foot trajectory through reconstruction, and the essence is still single-degree-of-freedom walking, with limited capacity and low efficiency. Aiming at the hexapod mobile platform based on hybrid-driven mechanism, this paper analyzes the reason why the hexapod platform cannot climb the step when the crank is single driven. After that, the article builds the inverse kinematics model of the leg through the bilateration matrix equation, analyzes the multi-solution problem in the solution, and finally realizes the established trajectory in the foot workspace through the dual-degree-of-freedom coupling drive, and drives the hexapod platform to climb the steps. Through this method, the hybrid-driven mechanism can no longer be limited to the fixed trajectory walking, and the capacity is improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Performance of Icing Simulator in an Open Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, the calibration of an open environment ice simulation device is studied, including the corresponding relationship between air pressure, water pressure and MVD, LWC, and the improvement of cloud uniformity and stability; At the same time, taking the engine icing test as the research object, the influence of engine size and suction flow rate on the icing cloud area is studied. Based on the research results, the test parameters are matched and designed; The test results show that the method of producing the icing environment in the open environment can be used to support the verification test of the anti icing under the simulated icing weather conditions for aircraft engine nacelle, and can be extended to the icing test of other types of engines.

articleTitle: Borehole Radar Response to Fracture Characteristics: A Forward Simulation Study
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Fractures with various scale and geometry are important geologic structures which play a crucial role for petroleum industry, engineering geology, and geothermal exploration and exploitation because of their high fluid permeability. In this paper, at first the borehole radar response to a thin fracture is analyzed based on the plane wave analytical method. It is found that the primary reflection and multiple reflections cancel each other in both water- and air-filled fractures because of their opposite phases, resulting in that the superimposed reflected signals are weaker than the primary ones. Furthermore, the numerical method of sub-cell FDTD technique is used to simulate the borehole radar response to fractures with width ranging from 0.0005m to 0.02m, and filled with water or air, respectively. Compared with air-filled fractures, water-filled fractures are easier to detect when the fractures are parallel to the borehole. Wider fractures can give stronger reflections and are easier to identify.

articleTitle: Implements of Transformer in NLP and DKT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Transformer is a strong model proposed by Google team in 2017. It was a huge improvement that it entirely abandons the mechanism of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Convolutional Neural Network (RNN). As a result, soon it became a popular choice in a diversity of scenarios. A typical implement of Transformer is for handling text-like input sequences, such as Natural Language Process (NLP) and Knowledge Tracing (KT). Although Transformer is a strong model, it still has a number of improvements. Some state-of-the-art Deep-Learning-based models (e.g., BERT in [2], SAINT in [3], etc.) are based on Transformer. In this paper, I give some examples of application of Transformer or Transformer-based models and summarize the pros and cons of Transformer.

articleTitle: DCPowerMan: A Power Management System for Data Center
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to make full use of the power resources in the data center, the data center power oversubscription scheme is generally adopted, which can increase the power efficiency and make full use of the cabinet space to deploy more computing resources. However, this solution will cause security risks. When the servers in the cabinet reach a high power level at the same time, the real-time power consumption on the power supply line will exceed the rated power consumption, causing the circuit breaker to trip, affecting the operation of the applications on the server and the users, or even burning down the server, causing irreparable damage. In response to the above problems, we propose DCPowerMan, a power management system based on (Average Runtime Power Limit) RAPL. When the server reaches a high power level, our system can give application migration suggestions and perform power management to reduce real-time power consumption and ensure power consumption safety. Experiments in a real computer room environment demonstrate the effectiveness of our system.

articleTitle: Drilling Axial Force Prediction Based on PSO-RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper focus on different parameters of casing drill on axial force in the process of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Plastic (CFRP) hole making and establish a reliable axial force prediction model, the influence law of each variable on axial force was analyzed based on response surface method with different parameters as design factors, and the Response Surface Methodology (RSM) empirical prediction model of axial force was constructed. Aiming at the problem of large error of RSM prediction model, the accuracy of axial force prediction model could be improved by optimizing Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBF-NN) through Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. The experimental results show that the influence order of the main factors on the axial force is feed > spindle speed > aperture. The average relative error of the PSO-RBF Neural Network (PSO-RBF-NN) prediction model is 3.27%, which is 17.60% lower than the standard RBF-NN prediction error, and 44.67% lower than the RSM empirical model prediction error.

articleTitle: Inverter Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Compressed Sensing and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The safety and reliability of the inverter are directly related to the normal operation of the system. In order to realize the diagnosis and precise location of the open-circuit fault of the three-phase voltage source inverter, and improve the efficiency of fault diagnosis. On the basis of studying the inverter in normal and fault conditions, a new fault diagnosis method for power tube open circuit is proposed. Compressed sensing (CS) is used instead of traditional Nyquist sampling to obtain inverter fault signals, and then the fault signals under different working states of the inverter are converted into grayscale images. The classification results are obtained through the deep learning convolutional neural network (CNN) model. The test results show that CNN has good accuracy and certain noise immunity for disturbance classification. Compared with other intelligent diagnosis methods, The open-circuit fault diagnosis method based on compressed sensing and deep learning has high feasibility and diagnostic accuracy, and can realize the diagnosis and precise location of the three-phase inverter open-circuit fault.

articleTitle: The Algorithm Researching of Hand Pose Estimation Based on 3D Joint Regression
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The RGB image is used for 3D hand pose estimation, and the Gaussian function is defined according to the kinematics principle to represent the thermal map dependency of the previous joint point of the finger on the next joint point. The convolution network is assembled through the tree structure through the branching strategy, and the tree branch hierarchical network algorithm framework is designed. The two-dimensional pose of the five single finger joint points of the hand is estimated according to the local pose characteristics, and then the three-dimensional joint normalization regression algorithm is used to estimate the full three-dimensional hand pose for the two-dimensional pose of the single finger joint points. When regularizing linear regression, all features are punished. The degree of punishment is selected by the optimization standard of the sum of squares of residuals. The heat map loss function and joint point regression loss function are set. The experiment is carried out on the CMU Panoptic Dataset and STB Dataset. The experimental results show the advantages of this method by comparing parameters with other methods.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Electric Power Data Remote Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to realize on-line monitoring of metering devices and real-time collection of important information of users, this paper proposes the overall structure model of the design and implementation of a remote power data acquisition system for a power supply company, and proposes various items that the system should meet according to actual needs. The technical structure, business function structure and network structure of the power data remote acquisition system are designed, and the main problems existing in the installation, commissioning and system operation and maintenance of the system are studied, especially the main index requirements and troubleshooting of on-site operation. The design integrates various advanced communication technologies such as GPRS/CDMA/SMS, low-voltage power line carrier, etc. with large-scale database, embedded computer and other technologies. Based on B/S and C/S modes, the main station, data acquisition layer, the design of the three-layer structure of the measurement monitoring layer and the complete realization of the system functions. A set of power user electricity information collection system integrating basic application, advanced application, operation management, statistical query and system management has been successfully established, which fully meets the needs of electric power enterprises for electricity consumption information collection and management of power users.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Method of Vehicle Moment of Inertia Based on BP Neural Network and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the development of the production technology of the automobile industry, the requirements for parameter accuracy in various motion states are becoming higher and higher in the process of automobile design. In order to improve the input accuracy of the moment of inertia value in the vehicle simulation, and then make the vehicle simulation get more accurate results, this paper proposes a vehicle moment of inertia prediction method based on BP neural network. Through the selection of the indicators affecting the moment of inertia, the sample data is determined, and the sample data is divided into training set and test set to train and verify the BP neural network prediction model. The results show that the accuracy of the moment of inertia predicted by the neural network is significantly higher than that calculated by the traditional empirical formula, and can be used in the process of automobile development. This paper uses big data and neural network to predict vehicle simulation input parameters, so as to obtain more accurate vehicle simulation results, which can be applied to other aspects of the vehicle simulation field.

articleTitle: Multi-task model-based float flowmeter readout algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to efficiently and quickly detect the float flowmeter indication, we propose a numerical reading algorithm based on the multi-task model named YOLO2R (You Only Look Once for Recognition of Reading). YOLO2R is composed of one encoder and two decoders. The improved CSPDarknet53 backbone and FPN feature pyramid network are used as encoders to extract the shared features. The two decoders are composed by object detection task and OCR text recognition task. The GRU recurrent neural network combined with spatial attention mechanism is used to decode the text in the target area. YOLO2R has achieved the state of the art in terms of accuracy and speed of multi-task learning models for high-precision real-time reading of float flowmeters.

articleTitle: Dataset Outlier Detection Method Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Outlier detection plays a very important role in real life, and requires long-term and continuous study and research in this field. The purpose of this paper is to study outlier detection methods for datasets based on the random forest algorithm. This paper briefly describes the research background and significance of the field of outlier detection, the research status at home and abroad, the application of outlier detection in various real-world scenarios, and some research problems that need to be solved urgently. The concept of outliers is summarized, and random forests and locality-sensitive hashing algorithms are briefly introduced. The RHSForest algorithm is proposed, the idea and process of the algorithm are discussed in detail, and the parameter settings and evaluation indicators are discussed in detail. Then the RHSForest algorithm is verified and evaluated by experiments. The experimental results are then analyzed, and the experimental results on 5 benchmark datasets show that the RHSForest algorithm has an AUC value of up to 95% in the Glass dataset, providing consistent performance improvements for the detection of outliers.

articleTitle: Realization of Online Intelligent Monitoring System for Steel Silo Based on Digital Twin Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Combined with the application status of thin-walled steel silo, the first online monitoring system of steel silo has been independently developed in China. It innovatively realizes online monitoring of structural stress and other parameters of steel silo, and further creates a theoretical system of digital twin monitoring theoretical system. It can realize early warning of faults, reduce potential risks and ensure the safety of production.

articleTitle: 3D Face Recognition Algorithm Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Although the depth learning algorithm reduces the workload of face recognition to a certain extent, the local characteristics of 3D face images is ignored, resulting in low accuracy of 3D face recognition. Therefore, this paper proposed a new 3D face recognition method using LBP algorithm improve depth belief network. Firstly, LBP algorithm and depth belief network are analyzed, and then LBP texture feature vector of 3D face image is obtained, which is used as the input feature of depth belief network to capture the local information of 3D face image. Finally, this paper designed a 3D face image recognition process and realized 3D face recognition based on improved depth belief network. The proposed method is trained on FERET face image database, and the simulation results show that the proposed method has higher 3D face recognition rate and shorter recognition time, compared with the comparison method, which shows that the application effect of the improved depth learning algorithm in 3D face recognition is better.

articleTitle: Research on the reliability of automotive sensors based on minimum relative information entropy
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Based on the principle of minimum relative information entropy, a new compound assignment method is proposed to establish an automotive sensor reliability evaluation model as an example. In order to improve the ease of use, a BP network is constructed with a single indicator as the collection sample and the diagnosis result as the output sample. It is verified by MATLAB simulation that the average relative error of prediction is 0.64% and the maximum relative error is 1.61%, which indicates that the model can give evaluation results quickly within a reasonable range and has certain application value for automotive sensor reliability evaluation.

articleTitle: A Fresh Way Targeted on Gear Malfunction Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: As the most common components in the transmission system of machine, gears play an extremely vital part in it. However, it is precisely because of the key of the gear that the failure of the gear in the mechanical system has become an vital part that cannot be ignored.
