Gear failures may occur due to production quality, transmission maintenance, or inevitable use and wear. When a gear failure occurs, the specific cause of the failure is unpredictable and occurs randomly. In actual engineering, it is not easy for us to check and determine the failure type of the gear in time. Therefore, an optimization way is urgently needed to timely detect and judge the malfunctions of gears in actual production. It can be known from practical experience that the malfunction of the gear will cause the system to show a unique vibration signal, which can be used to judge the malfunction of the gear. Thus, this paper simulates the occurrence of malfunction signals on the basis of finite element modeling to generate test samples for extreme learning machine training. The experimental results show that the fresh gear malfunction detection way is feasible and achieves the expected accuracy.

articleTitle: Contrastive Graph Learning for Session-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the problem that random deletion of graph nodes and edges may delete important item nodes when constructing graph structure enhancement samples in existing research work, which is not conducive to item node learning, this paper proposes a session-based recommendation method based on graph structure information enhancement. According to the importance of the nodes in the graph, the enhanced samples on the graph structure are constructed to enrich the representation of the item nodes. Firstly, our method constructs an item transfer graph according to the sequence of items interacted by the user, and then calculate the importance of the nodes and edges in the item transfer graph according to the in-degree and out-degree information of the user nodes in the graph. For important nodes and edges, we delete them with small probability. For the enhanced graph structure, we design contrastive learning on the graph structure to learn the representations of nodes on the graph. Finally, in the traditional conversation recommendation task, the auxiliary task of contrastive learning is added, and the multi-task learning framework is applied to learn the user's preference in session-based recommendation. Experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the performance of session sequence recommendation.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Classification of Aggregates based on SegFormer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Aggregate grading refers to the proportional relationship between the different particle sizes that make up an aggregate, and is a vital part of aggregate production. Aggregate grading is the first step in aggregate grading and the grading is of great importance to the quality of the aggregate grading. Traditional methods of grading artificial aggregates include the sieve method and the laser method. These methods are inefficient in performing aggregate classification and the accuracy of the test is subjectively influenced by the inspector. To solve this problem, the SegFormer algorithm was used to achieve intelligent classification of aggregates. The dataset was produced by photographing and labelling 200 top and 200 side views each from samples of aggregates provided by local aggregates companies. The SegFormer algorithm was used to semantically segment the image. Aggregate particle size was obtained by calculating the minimum circumscribed circle diameter of the coloured area in the top view segmentation result and the maximum inscribed circle diameter of the coloured area in the side view segmentation result to obtain the aggregate thickness. Combined aggregate size and thickness to determine the type of aggregate. The experiments show that the combination of SegFormer algorithm to achieve high accuracy and speed of intelligent classification of aggregates is of significant importance to the intelligent development of this industry.

articleTitle: Research on bench durability test technology of suspension based on virtual load
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Based on the virtual load and the spindle-coupled road simulation test bench, the bench durability test of the suspension is carried out, and the key technology research in the application process is discussed. It is proven that it is possible to complete the durability verification with a short cycle and high quality in the whole vehicle development process, and this test method will be widely used in the industry.

articleTitle: A Computer Vision Technology Applied in the Task of Mechanical Parts Inspection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, based on the computer vision detection technology, the parts detection system is studied and discussed. This system mainly uses manual image segmentation and other methods, which can fully avoid the defects of image segmentation, improve the accuracy of image detection and ensure the detection speed. The system uses CCD or CMOS digital camera to capture the image of parts on the assembly line, which is roughly divided into three parts. First of all, it is necessary to take the template image that fully meets the quality requirements of the parts, and carry out preprocessing such as smooth filtering for the image taken. Second, during the test, the image of the component to be tested is taken on the assembly line, and the position of the detection target image and the standard template image is registered through the image registration algorithm. Finally, the image features of each partition area of the image to be detected are extracted and compared with the features of each partition area of the standard template image, so as to detect the processing quality of the assembly line parts, whether there is a component assembly error, error prompt and alarm, so as to achieve intelligent detection Purpose.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Digital Receiver for Low Frequency Radio Astronomy
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The observation of low frequency radio band allows us to discover new radio astronomical objects and study the Cosmic Dwan (CD) and the epoch of reionization (EoR) of the Universe, since the emission from the neutral hydrogen 21 cm radiation of that period is redshifted to meter wavelengths. Measuring the global signals of 21cm emission require single antenna but extreme stable receiving system. In this paper, we describe the design and implementation of a low frequency receiving system to meet the requirement of such experiments. We also measure and show the basic specification of the rototype of the receiver, which serve as the foundation for the further development.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition of 10kV XLPE Cable Defects Based on CEEMD and Improved BP
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Partial discharge of cable is not only the main cause of insulation deterioration, but also the manifestation of insulation deterioration, so it is necessary to study the local laying of cable. A 10kV XLPE cable partial discharge detection experimental platform based on high-frequency current method was built in the high-voltage laboratory to detect the partial discharge signals of three types of typical cable defects, including metal impurities, main insulation water intake and main insulation scratches. Then the collected partial discharge signals were analyzed by complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD). The isentropic values of power spectrum entropy, energy entropy, approximate entropy and fuzzy entropy of each local laying signal are studied. The mean value of power spectrum entropy, energy entropy, approximate entropy and fuzzy entropy of each mode component are selected as the feature quantities, and the back propagation neural network algorithm is optimized by genetic algorithm for cable local laying pattern recognition. The results show that GA-BP can indeed improve the defect identification accuracy, which is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of power cables.

articleTitle: Research on VSG Energy Storage Control Strategy Based on Artificial Fish Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the integration of solar energy, wind energy and other new energy into the power system, the stability of the system has been greatly challenged. Virtual synchronization technology is a popular method to solve intermittent and random access of new energy sources. Energy storage device is the important support of virtual synchronization technology. In this paper, a variable coefficient control strategy is proposed for the control of energy storage device in virtual synchronization technology, and an improved artificial fish swarm algorithm is used for optimization. The simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can better control the output power of the controller in the VSG, and achieve the purpose of correcting the energy storage device.

articleTitle: Vocs Monitoring and Data Processing System Based on NB-Iot
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the rapid development of industrialization and urbanization, the demand for energy is increasing day by day, resulting in regional compound air pollution characterized by fine particles (PM2.5) and ozone (O3), which is seriously harmful to air quality and national health. At present, China is still dominated by end-treatment, lack of data monitoring and processing capacity for gas emissions, and the end-treatment is highly dependent on equipment, the cost of corporate governance is high, and the effect is limited. The project team plans to design a VOCs monitoring and data processing system based on narrowband Internet of things for long-distance and high-precision monitoring of VOCs, and distribute and optimize the collected data, at the same time, construct a real-time regional gas distribution model according to the data of each monitoring node, and feedback the VOCs emission information to the local environmental protection department in real time, so as to help local departments grasp the gas distribution of VOCs in real time and accurately, and then play the role of early warning.

articleTitle: Design of Substation Intelligent Inspection Scheme Based on Multi-Dimensional Inspection Robot System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The digital transformation of substation is imminent. According to the business situation in the actual operation of substation, this paper analyzes the pain points of the existing substation operation inspection work, puts forward the overall framework of substation intelligent inspection based on the multi-dimensional inspection robot system of substation, and constructs the technical framework and implementation ways of each sub business module according to various business needs. Based on the data sharing and intelligent algorithm of the multi-dimensional inspection robot system, the functions of each sub business module are integrated to build a complete substation intelligent inspection solution, which provides a new idea for the intelligent upgrading of substations.

articleTitle: Research on an Environment-controlled Boat Verification Device
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Due to the limitation of the environmental conditions on the boat measurement, and under the urgent demand of the instrument measurement in the boat, an environmentally controlled boat verification device is designed. The device focuses on solving the problem that the verification and measurement cannot be conducted under the harsh environmental conditions, and focuses on the constant temperature and constant humidity technology under the high temperature environment, as well as the structure design of the split verification cabin. It provides the automatic adjustment and control function of the micro-environment, so that the verification environment is always in the temperature and humidity index requirements required for the measurement. The verification device follows the design principles of lightweight, modularization, intelligence and standardization, and analyzes the research results that the verification device meets the actual needs, and can solve the environmental condition guarantee problem of on-site metrological verification. It provides a new idea for the subsequent exploration of the new measurement guarantee mode of boat instruments.

articleTitle: Thermoelectric Coupled Analyses of the Thermal and Electric Fields at the Tulip Contact for a Medium-Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The key issue in thermos-electrical analysis of medium voltage switchgear is the heat due to electric contact. In this paper, a novel thermoelectric coupled model is developed for quantitative analysing the temperature field. It shows that the high temperature region located at the tulip contact due to severe contact resistance there. Due to aging of the springs used for holding the tulip contact fingers, the lacking of holding force may lead to less contact areas between the tulip fingers and the static/moving arms, which can lead to a severe increase of the contact heat generation rate. Thus, severe temperature rise may occur and lead to an overheating problem in a medium voltage switchgear. It lays solid foundation for maintaining and operating of the switchgear.

articleTitle: A Test Scheme Design of Chinese Speech Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics and classification of the current speech recognition system, the existing test scheme and the existing problems. On this basis, a test scheme is provided for voice detection speech recognition system. By establishing a voice sample library to store test samples, the storage of command words, the selection of combinations and the reproduction of test conditions are realized, and the utilization rate and efficiency of test samples are improved. Combined with the actual application environment of the speech recognition system, the test system has carried out the test environment classification test scheme, carried out the pure environment command word test and the interference environment fault tolerance test, respectively characterized the speech recognition system's ability to recognize itself and adapt to the environment, and directly output the test results. Through experimental verification, this scheme can improve the accuracy of the test results of the speech recognition ability test, and improve the horizontal comparability of the related sound detection systems.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Withstand Voltage Test Device
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: As the scale of China’s power grid continues to expand, the daily workload and difficulty of the power industry has increased. Withstand voltage testing is an important part of it, and the demand for automated equipment has risen significantly, and the research of withstand voltage robots The research and application of withstand voltage robot has become inevitable. The purpose of this study is to develop an device for withstand high-voltage testing, which is controlled by an STM32 microcontroller to perform high-voltage tests instead of manually. In addition, there is a controller that can be controlled remotely using the network built inside the device. At the same time, the device can automatically detect and lift the test bench, and the algorithm written to achieve the planning of the travel route of the machine device.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Mileage Prediction Model using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Based on the real driving data of electric vehicle, this paper takes the variables such as voltage, current and temperature as the object, and optimizes the data structure by SVM and other methods. Two BP neural networks are established, and combined with the corresponding relationship between SOC and driving mileage, the driving mileage is predicted according to the working condition parameters. Finally, it reaches a good level in the test set, and the mean square error is 10.87%.

articleTitle: Study on Overload Characteristics of Projectile Penetrating Target at High Speed
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of the structural parameters of the projectile on its dynamic characteristics when it penetrates the target plate at high speed is studied. Through theoretical analysis of the dynamic equation of the projectile penetrating the target plate, the overload characteristics of the projectile penetrating the target with different structural parameters are numerically simulated and analyzed using the ANSYS computer modeling and the appropriate grid model and calculation model. The simulation results show that the overload peak value of the missile body decreases with the increase of the length diameter ratio of the missile body and the shape coefficient of the warhead, and the shape coefficient of the warhead also has an impact on the arrival time and duration of the overload peak value. The overload peak value of the missile body can be reduced by increasing the length diameter ratio of the missile body and the shape coefficient of the warhead. The research results can provide a reference for the damage effectiveness evaluation of the structural design of high-speed missile body.

articleTitle: Design of A New Single Portable Six Foot Robot Based on Curved Foot
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, based on the advantages of wheeled robot and foot robot, a six foot mobile robot based on the arc foot propulsion mechanism is designed. The robot has a compact structure and light weight, which can meet the needs of single soldier operations. This paper mainly introduces the overall design of six legged robot, and the selection and checking of the robot driven motor is also introduced in detail. In addition, the structural design of the curved leg is described in detail. The 3D modeling of parts and robots is completed by using PROE software.

articleTitle: Research on Strategy of Heat Supply Based on Intelligence Control
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: To actively respond to the strategic goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutralization proposed by Chinese government, the reform of heat supply is an important research hotspot. Intelligence control technology is used to propose the adaptive distributed heat suppling strategy. Firstly, the data monitoring platform with distributed control points performs as the core. The data resources are sampled and analyzed to realize the visual modeling of distributed databases. Secondly, the platform of distributed databases is established to model the underlying data as a whole for realizing the data- driven model. The preprocessing, filtering, cleaning and mining processes of data resource establishes a multi-level model for analysis of running data. Lastly, the application of the heat suppling strategy not only overcomes the overall variation in practice, but also optimizes the data structure and realizes comprehensive data analysis for different objects. It provides technical support for the green, low-carbon and energy-saving running of the enterprise for the goal of "carbon peaking & carbon neutrality".

articleTitle: A Evolutionary Behavior Tree AI for Neural MMO Challenge
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The Neural MMO Challenge aims to study robustness and teamwork in large-scale multi-agent environments. AI needs to explore, search and fight in large-scale environments, and get higher scores than other competitors. Therefore, we developed AI based on evolutionary behavior tree, which has the advantages of strong interpretability, low coupling between modules and strong robustness. Specifically, the AI adopts the idea of divide and conquer, divides the decision-making into two levels: team and individual, divides the four task achievements into several subtasks, finds appropriate agents for each subtask according to the current advantages, and then completes specific actions such as attack, foraging, avoidance and collaboration, and optimizes the parameters with evolutionary strategy algorithm.AI won the silver medal in IJCAI 2022 Neural MMO Challenge.

articleTitle: Structure Recognition for Object Detection and Tracking Based on Star Catalogue
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: When the queue constituted by warcrafts and ships are deployed, they often move in fixed formation, which like the structure of galaxies in the universe. This work proposes a structure recognition like star pattern matching. It connects each of the three targets into a triangle, then get the angle and sides from the point we interest. In the next frame, triangle similarity will be used to match the structure from previous "star catalogue". This work changes the pixel-level feature of image into a simple "star catalogue". The star catalogue provides a huge help to detection and tracking in fixed formation because it records key information between different object. In the experiment, the method has achieved high accuracy with its characteristics of light weight and fast.

articleTitle: Effect of capacitance parameters on the performance of fast repulsion mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The fast repulsive mechanism plays a key role in the fast mechanical switch, which controls the closing of the dividing and closing gates, and the main motion process can be decoupled into two parts: the field and the road. In this paper, starting from the road part, we first briefly outline the working principle of the fast repulsive mechanism, use MAXWELL to build a two-dimensional model, and simulate different values of capacitance parameters. Afterwards, prototype tests are performed and the actual values are compared and analyzed with the simulation so as to verify the simulation structure. The test shows that the simulation results and the test results in the three cases of 4mF capacitance, 10mF capacitance and 15mF capacitance are highly fitted with small errors based on the analysis of the effect of capacitance parameters on the performance of the fast mechanical switch test prototype. In order to meet the requirement of long stroke, the capacitance value should be reduced appropriately in the subsequent study.

articleTitle: Application of machine learning algorithm in porosity calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Reservoir porosity is an important parameter to reflect reservoir performance. At present, the logging data with high correlation with core analysis porosity and porosity are usually selected to build a multiple linear regression model to calculate reservoir porosity. Some formation porosity information may be lost due to the ignorance of logging data with low correlation, and the multicollinearity of the variables may lead to the instability of the regression model when using logging data for multivariate comprehensive analysis and increase the calculation error .In view of the above problem, this paper comprehensive reaction formation acoustic, electric, properties of well logging data, using principal component regression (PCR) algorithm, Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm to optimize the BP neural network and multiple linear regression, respectively, on the porosity in Q4 target calculation, the results showed that LM - BP neural network, PCR and the relative error of the multiple linear regression were 7.10%, 10.63% and 14.99% respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction System of Computer Big Data Security Platform Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current network security situation in the era of big data. At the same time, the author summarizes the theory of network security management from the aspects of risk control and security assessment. On this theoretical basis, a network security management platform based on artificial intelligence big data is constructed. The platform has built a complete network security situational awareness and early warning architecture that integrates data collection and sorting, data storage, offline analysis and discovery, real-time correlation detection, threat warning and situation presentation, and supports the whole process of security event processing. The experimental results prove that the multi-model ensemble algorithm used in the proposed system combines the advantages of each model, making the overall accuracy rate up to 99.24%.

articleTitle: Algorithm Optimization of Deep Reinforcement Learning for Traffic Signal Control of Municipal Road Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Urban road traffic signal control is the key factor affecting the road capacity, but due to the strong randomness of traffic flow, the traditional inductive control method only considers the current phase of vehicle arrival information, which has great limitations. In the stage of intelligent traffic signal control and regulation of traffic engineering, we should do a good job in traffic flow prediction, intelligent traffic signal regulation and control, as well as hardware and software control, so as to improve the quality of intelligent traffic signal control and regulation of traffic engineering. Taking the municipal road at a single intersection as an example, this paper applies deep learning to predict the municipal traffic flow, and then optimizes the deep reinforcement learning algorithm for its traffic signal control and carries out information modeling. The conclusion is that the traffic signal control effect based on algorithm optimization is significantly better than the traditional timing control method, which can effectively reduce the probability of traffic accidents and realize the intellectualization of municipal traffic engineering.

articleTitle: Application of TVFEMD-SVD and LSTM in Rolling Bearing Troubleshooting
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the maintenance of machinery and equipment, the most inevitable thing is to figure out the type of rolling bearing failure. However, it is often difficult to extract and identify the fault features of rolling bearings. In this paper, time-varying filtered empirical mode decomposition (TVF-EMD) combined with singular value decomposition (SVD) and long short-term memory (LSTM) classification models are applied to rolling bearing fault identification. The method first decomposes the original sampled signal by TVF-EMD to obtain the intrinsic mode function (IMF) component composed from high frequency to low frequency. It then filters out the IMF that best characterizes the original signal by using kurtosis criterion to form the initial feature vector matrix. Subsequently, it decomposes it by SVD and constructs the feature vector by using the singular values obtained from the decomposition as the feature parameters. Finally, the feature vector matrix is finally analyzed using LSTM to build an LSTM classification model to identify the bearing fault type. Three other methods have been tried and compared with the method proposed in this paper. The results verify that the method proposed in this paper is better, and the simulation performance indicated that the method achieves 98.75% fault recognition for rolling bearing.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a new variable configuration electric vertical take-off and landing urban air traffic vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In response to the growing traffic congestion in countries around the world, the idea of urban air traffic solutions has been proposed internationally. The electric vertical take-off and landing vehicle (eVTOL) was born out of this idea. Existing vehicles of this type have obvious problems in terms of take-off and parking footprint, and in terms of energy conversion efficiency of aerodynamic forces during normal flight. Based on these problems, this paper proposes a hybrid variable configuration layout eVTOL vehicle based on a hydraulic-linked rotating mechanism. In this design, the rotating and folding wing design revolutionises the problem of large space occupation during take-off and parking, while the hybrid power system layout with vertical take-off and landing and fixed wing flight modes successfully changes the poor endurance of this type of aircraft. Through motion simulation and dynamic finite element analysis, the key parameters of this design have achieved the design objectives. The design also relies on the low latency characteristics of 5G technology and the urban transportation network under the sharing economy, and further proposes a low usage threshold framework for unmanned vehicles, which will help China's future intelligent air transportation system to lead the development.

Author Keywords: electric vertical take-off and landing vehicle

articleTitle: STM32-Based Design of Racecar Running Status Monitoring System and Instrument Display
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet and instrument display technology in the era of big data, there is need to help the driver learn the racecar running status in various racing competitions. Meanwhile, field personnel need to timely monitor the racecar running state. Based on STM32 single chip microcomputer, with LORA spread spectrum technology as the main information transmission and wireless communication basis, and UART serial port as the data transmission module, the racecar running status monitoring system and instrument display system are designed to achieve wireless monitoring of the racecar running status in real time through the instrument panel and the host computer.

articleTitle: Design of Gearbox Monitoring System Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the advent of Industry 4.0 and the Industrial Internet, the Internet of Things (IoT) development of applications is booming, the mining machinery working environment is extremely harsh, therefore, the requirements of the performance, quality, durability, reliability of its gearbox is pretty high, to meet these requirements, real-time monitoring is becoming a demanded task. For this purpose, a gearbox monitoring system based on edge computing is established. In the paper at hand, a novel Jacobi-type data parallel processing method is proposed, with which, the efficiency and life of the gearbox are calculated through the edge service APP. Traditional methods by solely utilizing cloud computing cannot effectively accomplish this task. Using cloud-edge collaboration technology, the Web application in scenarios such as intelligent mining is designed, which can grasp the operating status of equipment in the entire mining area, unify scheduling and orchestration of computing resources, update the monitoring model on edge computing nodes, and process and generate effective data of machinery and equipment in real-time at the edge computing device. It reduces the operation and maintenance cost, solves the problem of monitoring data congestion caused by insufficient data bandwidth, and ensures a stable and safe operation of mining machinery.

articleTitle: Design, Analysis and Verification of New Vehiclemounted Antenna Lifting Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the need of automatic lifting and lowering of the vehicle-mounted antenna, a new type of lifting platform that can meet the lifting and roll-up of the vehicle-mounted antenna is designed. The structure design, control design, model selection check, finite element analysis of key components and safety performance analysis of the new lifting platform are expounded. The new lifting platform is easy to install and easy to operate, and has the characteristics of low noise, high intelligence, high reliability, and high maintainability. It can well meet the lifting needs of vehicle-mounted equipment and has a wide range of application scenarios.

articleTitle: Discussion on thermal management of high power liquid-cooled charging components and related testing standards
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: High power liquid-cooled charging components are different from conventional charging components in thermal management. Based on conventional charging components, the high power liquid-cooled charging components uses liquid -cooled pipes in charging cables to remove heat from conductors for increasing the current-carrying capacity, and reduces the cross-sectional area of conductors to reduce cable weight to improve user experience. If the high power liquid-cooled charging components overheat or leakage occurs during actual use, safety accidents may occur that may endanger the personal safety of users. In order to better understand the high power liquid-cooled charging components, this paper mainly discusses the working principle of high power liquid-cooled charging components, the selection of liquid coolant, thermal management strategy and related test standards.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Influence of Different Activation Functions Based on Deep Learning Model for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Facial expressions are an important channel for people to communicate their emotions. To more accurately recognize people's facial expressions, researchers are constantly exploring the possibilities of convolutional neural networks. For convolutional neural network models, many factors can have a significant impact on the performance, including the structure and parameters. In this paper, it analyze the impact of different activation functions on the deep learning model of facial expression recognition with the FER-2013 dataset, compare the advantages and disadvantages between traditional and new activation functions, and finally build a deep learning model of facial expression recognition with better performance. In addition to the baseline CNN model, the paper also analyzes the performance of famous deep learning models such as ResNet, VGG and Inception, from which the best-performing baseline CNN model is selected to explore the impact of different activation functions. The results show that the GELU activation function-based facial expression deep learning model has the best performance and the highest recognition accuracy among the activation functions ReLU, L-ReLU/P-ReLU, Swish, etc. Compared with the deep learning model with the traditional ReLU activation function, the facial expression deep learning model based on GELU activation function constructed in this paper approximately improves the accuracy by 1%.

articleTitle: Research on Control of the Automatic Driving Robot Based on Kinematics and Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The automatic driving robots can replace vehicle drivers in traditional car tests and ADAS tests, and can also realize automatic driving of vehicles. Based on the kinematics and dynamics model, the trajectory planning of the vehicle can be more convenient to control the vehicle speed and path tracking, and at the same time can control the car to do some high-risk tests. This program first establishes the vehicle kinematics and dynamics model, based on the MPC strategy, and integrates the lateral and the longitudinal control, and finally drives the robot to realize the control of the vehicle. The self driving robot uses Visual Studio to write the upper computer software, which has achieved excellent human-computer interaction effect, and verified this statement through vehicle testing. The experimental results show that the lateral control strategy based on model predictive control can well realize the real-time control of vehicle steering by the robot, and the longitudinal precise control of the vehicle by the robot can also be realized based on the kinematics and dynamics models.

articleTitle: Global Context Enhanced Item Learning for Session-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Session-based recommendation is a challenging task, which aims at recommending items based on user behavior sequences. Robust item representation learning has a great impact on improving recommendation performance. Existing session-based recommendation methods randomly initialize items into low-dimensional vectors, and then simultaneously train the item representations when training the session-based recommendation model. Existing approaches do not make full use of user historical interaction data. In order to make full use of user interaction data, we first construct a global item transition graph based on all user interaction data, and then apply a graph neural network to learn the item representation in the item transition graph. The downstream session-based recommendation models learn user preference and give recommendation results based on the global item representation. Our proposed global context item learning method can effectively utilize the global item transition knowledge, thus can learn rich item representations. We conduct inclusive experiments on three common datasets, and the results show the effectiveness and the efficiency of our proposed framework.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Research of Power Forecasting Based on LSTM Time Series
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Power forecasting has always been an important topic in the smart grid and electricity market. Realizing power forecasting can effectively reduce the waste of energy and play a crucial role in promoting the consumption of new energy and the clean and low-carbon transformation of the energy system Traditional power prediction methods are difficult to make accurate predictions. In deep learning, a Long Short Term Memory network (LSTM) is more effective for processing and predicting time series problems. Therefore, in order to improve the prediction accuracy and optimize LSTM, this paper proposes a combination model -- CONV-LSTM model. That is, two convolutional layers are used, the data is read at a time, and then convolved at these time steps. Through comparison and evaluation with the naive model, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model, and LSTM model, it proves its rationality and effectiveness. In this paper, root means square error (RMSE) is selected as the evaluation index, which is more convenient and effective to evaluate by score. Compared with the results, it can be seen that the RMSE score of the CONV-LSTM model is the lowest, which indicates that the model with two convolution layers is more stable than that with only one convolution layer, which proves the feasibility of CONV-LSTM and effectively improves the prediction accuracy, which is of practical significance to society and power companies.

articleTitle: Elderly Nursing Service System Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm for Camera Calibration
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: It is the obligation of future generations to ensure that the elderly can enjoy their old age happily and comfortably. It is also a manifestation of social civilization and progress, and it is the inheritance and development of the traditional virtues of the Chinese nation. The purpose of this paper is to study the construction and optimization of elderly care service system based on particle swarm algorithm. The basic principles of the construction of the elderly care service system, the specific content of the optimization of the service, and the hardware selection and implementation of the elderly care system are expounded, and the selection and calculation of each hardware of the system are carried out calibration and improve its calibration accuracy. The camera calibration based on improved particle swarm algorithm is applied to the system's physical sign detection module, and the reliability of data communication is tested. The average error rate of data communication is 0.33%, which ensures the safe and stable operation of the entire motion control system, making it a Simple and easy to operate.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Network Recommendation Algorithm Based on Graph Convolution
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: There are several types of objects and interaction relations in recommendation systems. However, most graph convolution models consider the network merely as a bipartite graph for convolution, as a result of which, the qualities of nodes in heterogeneous networks are underestimated under different interactions. Therefore, the present study aims at proposing a graph convolution recommendation algorithm for heterogeneous networks. The node interaction in the network were divided into two types of interactions, i.e., the homogeneous interaction and the heterogeneous one. Moreover, attention mechanism was used to extract the node features in the homogeneous interaction, which was subsequently integrated into the node features generated by the heterogeneous interaction convolution. Finally, to generate the prediction score, a multi-layer perceptron was used. Hence, the obtained results corroborated the better performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Supplier Evaluation Model of BP Neutral Network Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to improve the objectivity of the supplier evaluation process and overcome the shortcomings of BP neural network, such as weak generalization ability and more dependence on initial values, this paper constructs a supplier evaluation model of BP neutral network based on genetic algorithm to realize supplier multi-index evaluation in the supply chain, and provides model and method support for supplier evaluation research. Firstly, this model searches the weight and threshold within the set range by using the input customer index data, expected output and correlation function through genetic algorithm, and obtains a global approximate solution, which is used as the initial weight and threshold of BP neural network; then on this basis, BP neural network refines and adjusts the weights and thresholds until the optimal solution is obtained. The empirical results show that the model has strong self-organization, self-learning and self-adaptive ability, and the evaluation results of the model are objective and reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on the Identification of Artworks Based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the era of big data, digital recognition technology is particularly important, and with the continuous upgrading of relevant information technology, beyond recognition technology has been widely developed in various fields. Through computer information technology as a way of information transmission.it is the basis of digital image processing technology as well as related recognition technology. In the "metaverse" environment, a large number of outstanding paintings are made into digital images and used for "big data" recognition. In order to find such artwork images better and faster, a more scientific and effective recognition method needs to be explored. In this paper, we compare the advantages and disadvantages of feature extraction and classification design with existing methods, and improve and optimize the feature extraction and classification recognition algorithm after completing artwork pre-processing. Finally, the performance of the method is verified by experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent search algorithm under computer big data software technology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the algorithms based on the MapReduce model are constantly updated and optimized, and a number of typical algorithms and models have appeared in the academic world. These algorithms can be divided into Map stage algorithm, Reduce stage algorithm and iterative algorithm according to their own characteristics. After in-depth research, we found that the factors that affect the efficiency of algorithm execution include data scale, data structure and algorithm process. Through these discoveries, these different algorithms have different scopes of application. Various algorithms need to be selected according to the data scale and application situation, and then these various algorithms are combined to select the most appropriate intelligent search research.

articleTitle: IVSA: Facial Expression Recognition Method with Salient Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Recently, facial expression recognition (FER) has become an important topic in computer vision research. With the advance of artificial intelligence, the performance of model about FER has made great progress and improvement. To further enhance the ability of extracting significant features and enhancing the robustness of the model, we present a innovative facial expression recognition framework based on convolutional neural network and attention module. Concretely, we add the L2 norm features in CBAM and re-scale the channel weights. Salient attention block is used to suppress the insignificant feature and enhance the weight of salient features, which improves the performance and robustness of the model. Finally, without using extra training data, IVSA achieves the highest single-model accuracy of 72.44%, which is improved by 1.14% compared with the previous methods. Extensive experiments prove the effectiveness of the model and framework.

articleTitle: Data analysis and information visualization on the process of ship striking the anti-collision pier
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: China has rich navigation resources, and the long and narrow inland waterways determine the complexity of navigation environment. As a common component of land transportation facilities, Bridges directly increase the risk of inland river navigation in the distribution of inland water systems crisscrossed by crisscrossed paths. In order to ensure the safety of Bridges, a lot of research have been carried out on bridge collision prevention. In this paper, the reliability of a bridge collision prevention facility is verified by simulation experiments. The simulation results show that the duration of ship collision avoidance facilities is usually no more than 2 seconds, and the peak of relevant force appears about 0.5 seconds after the collision. Friction and impact forces usually do not change significantly. During this process, the bow changes less.

articleTitle: Research and Calculation of Power Supply and Distribution Line Design Based on Immune Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The layout of urban buildings is complex and the demand for electrical energy is large. In the face of a large number of electrical equipment, a reasonable selection of the installation location of the distribution box can not only effectively reduce the initial investment cost, but also is extremely important to reduce the loss of power lines during operation. Since the traditional load moment calculation method needs to manually select which electrical equipment the distribution box will supply power to, different choices have different results, and the human factor is dominant. The target is automatically calculated by the immune optimization algorithm, and the optimal installation position of the distribution box is found according to the estimated number of distribution boxes, which greatly improves the reliability and economy of power supply. Taking 30 load demand sides as an example, when 4, 5, 6, and 7 distribution boxes are installed, the total load centers are located at (16.7977,8.5681), (19.3078,6.8543), (15.7810,9.5505), (21.1060,14.9943) respectively, which verifies the feasibility of the immune optimization algorithm in the location selection of distribution boxes. Effectively reduce the initial investment cost.

articleTitle: Conformance requirements and test standard research for communication protocols of electric vehicle wireless power transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Communication conformance is an essential link to ensure the application of electric vehicle (EV) wireless power transfer (WPT) systems in a public place. It is necessary to standardize the communication interconnection between vehicle assembly (VA) and ground assembly (GA) produced by different device manufacturers in a standardized way, so as to ensure the safe and stable operation of EV WPT systems. This paper introduces conformance requirements and test standard research progress for communication protocols of EV WPT systems, including the conformance test method, conformance test requirements, and conformance test system. In addition, the power transfer process with respect to communication and the communication message format and content between the ground communication service unit (CSU) and in-vehicle unit (IVU) of EV WPT systems are also presented.

articleTitle: Application of Online Bypass Intelligent Device in Discovering Process Error of New Energy Batter
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: At present, in new energy battery factories, the weighing equipment for precious raw materials cannot automatically identify errors, but manual discovery and adjustment are needed, which may cause upstream mixing errors and therefore huge losses to the enterprise. For non-intelligent equipment used for weighing in new energy battery factories, this paper designs an online bypass intelligent device in detail. In the data preprocessing stage, a new method is proposed for solving extremum in finite-time sliding window. Able to efficiently extract the waveform amplitude value, this method has a time complexity of O(n) in operation. The extracted feature data is processed by replacing time value with sequence number value according to the idea of data set unification. In the intelligent agent modeling stage, by focusing on optimal planning principle of support vector machine, we refer to the sequence minimal optimization algorithm of support vector machine to achieve multi-classification of support vector machine. Using real factory data to simulate the error identification by the bypass device, the experimental results suggest that the device can correctly classify data into three categories, and generate on-site alarm signals according to the design idea.

Author Keywords: triple classification of support vector machine

articleTitle: Application of Key Technology of Station Topology Recognition Based on Multivariate Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the further development of our country's society and market economy, the requirements for electricity continue to expand, and the level of attention to the level of power supply services is also increasing. The low-voltage power supply system network construction is less intelligent, which increases the workload and difficulty of the daily operation and operation and maintenance management of power supply enterprises, and also seriously affects the user experience. How to locate and verify the topology in the station area, solve the blind spots of the station area's low-voltage power supply system in the network topology management, and implement intelligent management and control of the station area has begun to attract the attention of the majority of power companies. This paper aims to study the key technology of station topology recognition based on multivariate data. Based on the analysis and recognition technology, the problems in topology recognition and the steps of topology recognition, simulation models are built and simulation data are used to calculate examples of the proposed method. The results show that using the calculation method proposed in this paper, the impedance of the line can be calculated regularly and updated continuously.

articleTitle: Development of Gold Bracelets Automatic Calender Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper introduces a kind of equipment which can polish the surface of the golden bracelet by pressing. The power of this equipment mainly produced by 2 DC motor and a Stepping motor. The golden bracelet is supported by a support and the equipment is driven by the transmission group. This equipment only need we to put the golden bracelet on the suport, then the bracelet and the polishing needle are rolled by 2 DC motor and the Stepping motor make the bracelet swing in radial direction. This equipment has a simple structure and easy to operate. The application results shows that this equipment is able to polish the bracelet by pressing in a constant velocity and it could finish one in a minute, satisfing the need of automatic polishing.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Robot Arm for Navel Orange Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to better adapt to the development of contemporary fruit market economy, according to the growth environment of navel orange, a multi degree of freedom small navel orange picking manipulator is designed, which is of great significance to realize agricultural automation and improve economic benefits. This paper introduces the characteristics of navel orange tree and the parameters of navel orange firstly. According to the growth range and growth mode of navel orange, a new end effector is designed and the parameters of manipulator are determined. Secondly, the D-H method is used to analyze the forward and inverse solutions of the manipulator. Thirdly, the three-dimensional workspace of the manipulator is calculated by using MATLAB robot toolbox and Monte Carlo method, which further verifies that the length of each arm of the manipulator can meet the picking requirements. Finally, polynomial interpolation method is used to plan the path of the manipulator. Through the use of MATLAB robot toolbox, the kinematics simulation analysis of the manipulator is carried out.

articleTitle: Siting of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Based on User Behavior
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Electric vehicles are a promising development opportunity. Electric vehicle charging stations are reasonably planned and can appropriately reduce some unnecessary expenses of operators and users in terms of time and economy. Considering the construction and maintenance cost of EV charging stations and user cost based on user behavior, the location of EV charging stations is determined. A model is built based on an improved genetic algorithm. The global search capability of the genetic algorithm is enhanced by improving the crossover operator. Introducing the particle swarm algorithm to obtain new convergence conditions allows the genetic algorithm to avoid falling into a local optimum. Through the simulation of charging station siting in Shenzhen, the improved algorithm has a faster convergence rate and stronger global search ability, which can provide practical siting strategies for charging station siting in other places.

articleTitle: Analysis of Attitude and Heading Computer System in Magnetic Disturbance State
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: AHRS (Attitude and Heading Reference System) has low attitude accuracy under magnetic disturbance. Because of this, this paper designs an extended Kalman filter-based attitude and heading reference system in a magnetic disturbance state. In general, the AHRS system only uses the Kalman filter and has low attitude accuracy under magnetic disturbance. The AHRS system designed herein first calibrates the distorted magnetic field value under magnetic disturbance by using the ellipsoid fitting algorithm to improve the heading angle accuracy. After that, the data from the magnetometer, accelerometer, and gyroscope are combined using the extended Kalman filter technique. An adaptive measurement noise covariance matrix is created to lessen the influence of carrier vibration and external magnetic disturbance on attitude measurement, which enhances the system’s anti-interference ability and improves attitude measurement accuracy. Experiments show that the system can not only properly use the gyroscope’s drift but also improve the accuracy in attitude estimation, with the root mean square error of the three angles above 0.5°.

articleTitle: Transfering RGB-D Models to RGB by Multi-View Embedding Space Learning for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new framework for detecting objects in RGB images captured by conventional cameras by leveraging a set of labeled RGB-D data. We formulate this problem into a new multi-view learning problem, where we have the depth information in the training set that is not available in the testing set. To solve this problem, we use a three-view CCA learning method which combines visual features, depth features, and label information together to get the projection matrices. Sufficient experiments are done to demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, and improvement measures in the future are also proposed.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Fatigue Life of Large Straight Impact Reverse Circulation Drill Bits
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The large diameter percussive reverse circulation drill is widely used in large buildings, bridges and other projects in the drilling process. The structure fracture and weld cracking of the drill bit often happen because of the long suffering the effect of cyclic loading cycles. It is the primary cause for the low service life of the drill bit. This paper uses ANSYS nCode DesignLife fatigue analysis software to evaluate and predict the fatigue life of the drill bit under normal working and eccentric load conditions. It Obtained the fatigue life of the drill bit and the dangerous point of fatigue failure. The structure of the original drill is optimized, which provides theoretical guidance for the further improvement of the large-diameter impact reverse circulation drill.

Author Keywords: Large Straight Impact Reverse Circulation Drill Bits

articleTitle: Design of Antibody Intelligent Detection Temperature Control System Based on Fuzzy PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the problems of low-temperature control accuracy and poor stability in antibody detection temperature control system, this paper combines fuzzy control and PID control to design an antibody detection temperature control system based on fuzzy PID algorithm. The simulation system of antibody detection temperature control was designed by Simulink, so that PID parameters could be adjusted adaptively. The experimental platform was built, and the thermoelectric cooler (TEC) was driven by the temperature control board to control the temperature change. The results show that the control precision of the fuzzy PID temperature control system is within ±0.1°C, and the heating rate reaches 1.71°C/s, which realizes high-temperature control precision, fast heating rate, and good stability, and can meet the temperature control requirements of antibody detection temperature control system.

articleTitle: Tendon Driven Dexterous Hand Operation Control Based on Impedance Control and Tension Restraint
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Tendon rope drive can greatly improve hand flexibility by setting the driving mechanism of the forearm. It has a relatively large advantage in the service industry, high-end flexible manufacturing and other applications of human-computer interaction and cooperation. To control the contact force within the appropriate limit range in the tendon drive dexterous hand finger operation space, an operating impedance control method of tendon-driven dexterous hand with contact force planning is proposed. First, design a contact force controller in the tendon space. Since the kinematic coupling between the joints of the tendon cord space controller can cause undesirable ascent, a path planning method is further adopted to reduce the upshoot effect. Co-simulation using MATLAB and ADAMS validated the controller. The simulation results show that through impedance control and tension management, the controller can constrain the tendon rope tension within the limit, and the contact force can track the contact force in a very short time. However, due to the joint coupling effect of the tendon cord space, the controller of the tendon space needs to plan a reasonable trajectory to eliminate the interference when the tendon rope is stretched. Therefore, the control effect of the controller is ideal and effective.

articleTitle: A Study of Reversible Data Hiding Technology with an Authentication Function
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Digital signature is a very effective verification tool in checking electronic documents, but it does not apply to digital image, because digital images can fail to be verified by a digital signature with slight interference. To achieve the dual purpose of both verifying the copyright information of a digital image and restoring the original image without loss, in this paper, we propose a reversible data hiding scheme with an authentication function. The digital signature is first QR-coded, then the disrupted confidential data is embedded into the digital image. When digital signature verification is performed, it is only necessary to restore the stego image to the original image and extract the QR code according to the reversible algorithm. The experimental results show that the reversible data hiding algorithm can be embedded in each image block with up to 6 bits of data, its embedding block ratio reaches 87.42% on the average, which effectively improves the embedding capacity while the quality of the carrier image remains relatively stable, and is also robust against non-deliberate attacks on image processing; the strong error correction capability of the QR code also improves the success rate of digital signature verification.

articleTitle: Pulmonary Nodule Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to improve the detection rate of early lung cancer, the SE attention mechanism module was introduced based on the improved YOLOv3 for pulmonary nodule detection, and the CIoU Loss Function was used to capture the pulmonary nodules in CT according to their size and morphology, etc. The experiments were carried out on the LIDC-IDRI dataset, and the accuracy of pulmonary nodule detection was improved, and the improved algorithm produced good results for the identification of pulmonary nodules.

articleTitle: Design of Comprehensive Energy System Considering Anomaly Detection of Multi-Energy Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Considering miscellaneous data and difficult management and control of all kinds of energy equipment, a comprehensive energy management and control system is designed and a multi-energy data anomaly detection method is proposed. Data architecture of the comprehensive energy system is designed first, and then the major modules are designed, including energy monitoring, power supply and distribution monitoring, energy analysis and energy diagnosis of the system. In view of the system classification architecture, all kinds of user layer system models are designed and illustrated in detail. Finally, the spectral clustering algorithm is improved by replacing the original spectral clustering with small batch average clustering. The data detection results are obtained based on multi-energy data. Through experimental verification, the results show that the proposed method can effectively detect the multi-energy abnormal data.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Intelligent Robots in Modern Cold Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the weak links such as cold storage inspection and logistics transportation, the most important nodes in the cold chain logistics industry, this paper proposes an intelligent cold storage robot, which replaces manual completion of equipment in special environments through highly intelligent robotics and image recognition technologies. The detection and diagnosis of the running status realizes the full coverage inspection of the equipment area. It has the functions of security inspection, logistics transportation, temperature and humidity, gas detection, various image recognition, attitude recognition, etc. It has been proved by empirical evidence that it has greatly alleviated the problem of weak personnel on duty, the security has been further improved.

articleTitle: Circular Interpolation Trajectory Control of Manipulator Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the arc trajectory control of manipulator, a simulation control based on LabVIEW is proposed to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm. This design is controlled by PC, connected with stepping motor through PCI bus, and the operation interface on PC is written by LabVIEW. This paper briefly summarizes the characteristics of virtual instrument technology LabVIEW software, designs a simple control system of stepping motor by using LabVIEW graphic programming language, and introduces the general process and method of virtual instrument programming. The system designed with LabVIEW has the characteristics of flexible control, strong man-machine interaction, friendly interface and convenient operation. The design of this system finds a common method for the design of virtual instrument.

articleTitle: Elderly Nursing Monitoring System Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: A very important issue in the development process of our country is the aging of the population. With the progress of society and technology, computer functions are becoming more and more abundant, communication technology is improving, and remote care monitoring systems arise. In order to solve the problem that the increasing number of elderly people makes their demand for long-term care gradually increase, this study based on the performance index of elderly care monitoring system, the composition structure and selection of DSP system and the D-SCT image processing of the care monitoring system, the system design and implementation of the elderly care monitoring system from the hardware and software system and the communication protocol. The final system experiments show that the safety factor of DSP-based elderly care monitoring system is as high as 1432, and the average safety factor of CTR and CBS systems is 166, so DSP is more suitable for designing elderly care monitoring system and can provide a safer and more effective monitoring system for elderly care.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Genetic Algorithm-based Optimization of Rescue Performance of Shear Breaking Expansion Attachment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Multi-objective genetic algorithm is an excellent algorithm for solving multi-objective optimization problems, which has been widely used to solve problems in the field of engineering. In order to make the shearing, breaking and expansion rescue attachment closer to the post earthquake rescue needs, the discrete element method is used to simulate and analyze the breaking function of the rescue attachment. Combined with the analysis of the structure and function, the position of the hinge points of the attachment is taken as the design variable, and the optimization objective is constructed based on the comprehensive performance. The optimal solution of multi-objective genetic algorithm Pareto solution set is selected by reference to the weight distribution of each evaluation indicator in the evaluation system of large multi-functional rescue attachments. The results show that the expanding performance and crushing performance of the rescue attachment are improved while easy to transport, which can promote the improvement of rescue efficiency.

articleTitle: Adaptive design and grasping motion analysis of a four-fingered dexterous hands
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This project intends to equip new irregular parts with strong adaptability grasping equipment, and it creates a four-finger dexterous hand with high dexterity and great adaptive capacity. Improving the structure by researching and analyzing the existing multi-finger dexterous hand structure and movement mode, creating a 3D model of the four-finger dexterous hand with SolidWorks software, and calculating the DH parameters and kinematics equation of the dexterous hand on this basis. The motion of a single finger was further analyzed using MATLAB software, and its motion parameters were determined. Simulating grasping in SolidWorks Motion was utilized to evaluate the rationality of its motion grasping, and the appropriate control system was built and selected at the same time. Finally, the conclusion was formed that the four-finger dexterous hand can adapt to gripping irregular parts, and plausible ideas and genuine parameters were offered for the dexterous hand's continued use and improvement.

articleTitle: Based on Adaptive Dynamic Programming Carbon Fiber Diagonal Loom Tension Control Method
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to solve the matters of poor tension control performance and weak anti-interference in warp tension control of carbon fiber diagonal loom, a tension control strategy based on adaptive dynamic programming is proposed. Above all, the let-off system tension control model is established after analyzing the weaving principle of carbon fiber loom. It considers the influence of opening mechanism. In the second place, based on the framework of ADHDP, BP neural network is utilized to design the action network, and wavelet neural network is used to design the critic network to enhance the ability of ADHDP to approach approximate and optimal control. Finally, the simulation control experiment of the tension system is carried out by using Matlab software. Compared with the classical ADHDP tension control, The action network and critic network are all designed by BP neural network. In the anti-interference response of the tension system state, the proposed tension control strategy shortens the response time by nearly 30.76 % and the overshoot by almost 23.3%. In the tracking response of the tension system state, the response time is shortened by nearly 32.9% and there is almost no overshoot. WNN-ADHDP tension control method improves the control accuracy and anti-interference ability of the tension system.

articleTitle: Insulator Pollution Degree Identification Method Based on Sampling Cloth and Layered Idea
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The insulator that plays an insulating role at one end of the high-voltage line is exposed to the air environment, and long-term pollution accumulation in a humid environment will cause flashover between the insulators, which will affect the power supply line and require greater cost to detect and repair. At present, the contact measurement method is used to detect the pollution on insulator surface by cleaning, and the non-contact measurement method uses the idea of characteristic band imaging, which can guide the regular cleaning of insulator surface. In this paper, a method is proposed to use layering ideas and machine learning algorithms on hyperspectral image of a sampling cloth wiped clean from the insulator surface to achieve insulator pollution detection. Hyperspectral data is a three-dimensional data cube with a large amount of data. Firstly, the idea of stratification is used to identify the interval where the ratio of non-soluble deposit density (NSDD) and equivalent salt deposit density (ESDD) of insulators is located, and then XGBoost machine learning algorithm is used to establish the regression detection model of salt density and grey density in the corresponding interval. The method has been proven to have high accuracy and feasibility, and can guide the regular cleaning of insulator surface pollution in practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Pedestrian Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The deep learning pedestrian detection algorithm has the advantages of convolutional neural networks. It can not only improve the shortcomings of poor region selection and poor feature extraction robustness in traditional detection methods, but also extract the feature information of pedestrians more accurately. Therefore, the efficiency of deep learning pedestrian detection greatly exceeds that of traditional detection algorithms. Based on this background, the purpose of this paper is to deeply analyze the application principles of pedestrian detection algorithms based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Recognition Method of Station Topology Based on Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the in-depth development of the refined work of power system marketing management, the correct topology information of the station area in the operating distribution files is of great significance to the application of line loss management, abnormal monitoring, and fault repair in low-voltage distribution networks. This paper studies the station topology identification method based on the measurement data, understands the station topology identification on the basis of literature data, and then designs the station topology identification method based on the measurement data, and conducts the design method the test results show that the recognition rate of the method proposed in this paper has reached 100%.

articleTitle: Research on Steel Surface Defect Algorithm Based on Deep Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper aims at the problems of hot-rolled-steel quality in industrial manufacturing and the difficulty of manual identification, low efficiency, and health hazards. We propose an end-to-end recognition method based on deep residual network to realize the automatic classification of hot-rolled steel surface defects. This method can effectively improve the production efficiency of hot-rolled steel. For the problem of insufficient negative sample data sets in the industrial field, we use varieties of data enhancement strategies to expand the original data, which solves the phenomenon of over-fitting due to insufficient samples during the model training process. The defect features are extracted through the CNN layer.
